caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a fluted bundt pan or ring-shaped baking mold. The pan is colored in various shades of brown, with darker and lighter areas creating a three-dimensional effect and highlighting the curves and ridges of the interior and exterior surfaces. The pan has a central cylindrical tube that rises from the base, characteristic of a bundt or tube pan, and the sides are evenly fluted with rounded grooves. The object is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional items or patterns. A signature in red ink appears to the left and below the object, reading "CHASE MOSS NOV '33."
title: Cake Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
